highlights.title: Elon Musk's xAI sues Minnesota over law to ban 'nudify' apps
highlights.description: Elon Musk's xAI, now owned by SpaceX, is challenging a law that would ban so-called nudify apps in Minnesota

alsoIn.title: xAI is challenging a new Minnesota law banning 'nudify' apps

highlights.title: OpenAI’s Rogue AI Agent Hacked More Than Just Hugging Face
highlights.description: In a new disclosure, OpenAI says its agent used exposed logins to gain access to at least four “publicly available services” in its unhinged quest to solve a test.

alsoIn.title: OpenAI says the rogue agent that hacked Hugging Face also breached other services

highlights.title: Tech stocks extend sell-off with SoftBank losing 7% as AI plays take a hit
highlights.description: Chinese internet stocks listed in Hong Kong bucked the broader regional weakness with Tencent, Meituan, Baidu and Kuaishou all trading higher.

highlights.title: Cyera agrees to acquire Oasis Security for $1B to safeguard proliferating AI agents
highlights.description: The deal is Cyera's third acquisition this year.

highlights.title: OpenAI's First Devices: Speaker, Smartphone, and More
highlights.description: OpenAI's hardware roadmap has sharpened considerably in recent months, with its first device now identified, a smartphone said to be arriving as soon as next year, and a wider lineup taking shape behind them. AI Smart Speaker OpenAI's first product is a portable, screenless smart speaker developed with former Apple design chief Jony Ive, designed to act as a personal companion in the home rather than a conventional voice assistant. highlights.title: SK Hynix shares tank as exponential earnings growth fails to satisfy AI-charged expectations
highlights.description: SK Hynix shares fell as exponential profit and revenue growth failed to meet analysts' lofty expectations for a darling of the artificial intelligence sector.

highlights.title: China’s Moonshot AI Passes Funding Goal to Hit $35 Billion Value
highlights.description: Moonshot AI secured a $35 billion valuation after raising a larger-than-anticipated $3.5 billion in a just-closed round of financing, riding the momentum from a breakthrough Kimi K3 model that sent ripples through Silicon Valley.

highlights.title: SK Hynix Drops as Profit Disappoints
highlights.description: SK Hynix shares slide by a daily record of around 19% in Seoul Wednesday, erasing early gains after the memory maker reported lower-than-expected operating profit for the second quarter and announced plans for higher spending. The company earmarked at least $31 billion in capital spending this year after reporting a six-fold surge in quarterly profit. Bloomberg's Anthony Stephens reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: Developer uses AI to bring a native version of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time to iOS — no emulation required to play one of gaming's all-time greats on an iPhone or iPad
highlights.description: A developer has used OpenAI's Codex and GPT-5.6 Sol to help port a native version of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time to iOS and iPadOS devices.

highlights.title: Legrand Lifts Outlook as Clients Pour Billions Into Data Centers
highlights.description: Legrand SA boosted its sales guidance as customers continue to invest heavily in artificial intelligence infrastructure.
